name: 隐梦交织
detailed_description:
Interwoven Dream is a visual novel inspired by real historical events, enriched with elements of CRPG. Four protagonists must unravel several mysteries within seven days — the disappearance of young women, horrifying serial murders — ultimately sparking a social transformation.

Players can choose between two main protagonists: private investigator Gilbert Peterson, a sharp-witted gentleman detective, and Marguerite Gulden, an ambitious and insightful female journalist. Each character has distinct personality traits, areas of expertise, social affiliations, and personal flaws.

The game may expand to include four POV characters in the future, such as Ramsey Corbin, a charming politician, and Eleanor Vost, a mysterious young "widow." Both are already featured in the demo as optional allies during key events.

· Strategic Direction

You can take some matters into your own hands, but others are better left to someone else. You may rule the headlines, but that won’t help you dodge a flying fist.

· Narrative Perspective

Some characters may appear innocent and loyal to you — but show their true fangs when you're not looking.

· Storytelling Style

Some break doors with their fists. Others kill with the stroke of a pen.

Rise the storm, unveil the conspiracy!

A vast branching narrative and richly written text will shape multiple worldlines — paths that players can truly influence. Decide the fates of NPCs, your own destiny, and the turning points of history. Some may go astray, cross the seas, or rise anew and fight to the very end.

History is yesterday, and today. Perhaps we shall not let it become tomorrow.

Millennium Nocturnes is a fledgling game studio, currently composed of two producers.

short_description: 《Interwoven Dream》 is a Victorian-era visual novel with multiple POVs. In 1884 London, four friends reunite after a string of disappearances, each with their own motives. Together, they dive into the city's darkest secrets, where dreams and reality blur.
